newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady on limited arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady on limited arrivals.

text.p: Indian sugar prices held steady at reduced level on Thursday with consumer demand low but limited arrivals keeping market at last levels, dealers said.
Arrivals from millers remained low as most of the delivery tenders out of the free sale quota for current month are over.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,225/1,260 rupees per quintal while M-30 was steady at 1,265/1,360 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was not traded.
